discovery_notes: WDW 2019 OE backfill; 30 WebSearch calls, all search_snippet. Mostly Disney Pins Blog weekly roundups plus WDWNT Halloween/holiday/GE posts. Many roundup pins were sold at both DLR and WDW. GE OE sets first spotted at Disneyland June 2019. Possible overlap: DPB Mickey & Minnie holiday set vs WDWNT candy cane set kept separate. 2020-dated pins released Dec 2019 excluded (belong to 2020).
